symptom_in_logs: Recorded optical pass disagrees with the released acceptance sheet.
hidden_cause: Inspection packet contains a superseded optical acceptance revision.
red_herring: All affected units share one incoming dome lot.
cheat_fix: Relabel the old sheet as current.
real_fix: Replace the packet with the approved revision and reinspect retained samples.
fa_test_that_discriminates: Blindly rescore retained samples using both signed acceptance revisions.

symptom_in_logs: Audit sample count is lower than the approved lot plan.
hidden_cause: The inspection schedule omits the final partial tray.
red_herring: The final tray was assembled on the late shift.
cheat_fix: Exclude the partial tray from the denominator.
real_fix: Correct the sampling schedule and audit the omitted tray.
fa_test_that_discriminates: Reconcile serialized tray counts with signed audit records.

symptom_in_logs: T-PWR-01 rail_mv falls below 3250 under load.
hidden_cause: A fractured power joint adds series resistance.
red_herring: Battery lot changes near the first failure.
cheat_fix: Lower the rail-voltage limit.
real_fix: Replace the affected board and correct the joint process.
fa_test_that_discriminates: Measure the voltage drop across the joint under a calibrated load.

symptom_in_logs: T-IMU-01 bias_dps exceeds 0.5 after handling.
hidden_cause: A cracked inertial sensor package shifts the zero-rate output.
red_herring: The units share a firmware revision.
cheat_fix: Subtract one fleet-wide bias constant.
real_fix: Replace damaged boards and remove the package-stress source.
fa_test_that_discriminates: Compare zero-rate readings before and after replacing only the sensor package.

symptom_in_logs: T-AUD-01 snr_db is low across temperatures.
hidden_cause: Debris attenuates one microphone acoustic port.
red_herring: Failures cluster in a warm staging area.
cheat_fix: Increase microphone gain until the test passes.
real_fix: Clear the port and add a port-cleanliness check.
fa_test_that_discriminates: Measure each microphone path before and after removing the obstruction.

symptom_in_logs: T-IMU-01 bias_dps remains high after fixture movement.
hidden_cause: The sensing element has not recovered from a saturating mechanical impulse.
red_herring: One test-software build was installed that morning.
cheat_fix: Discard all high-bias readings.
real_fix: Allow a measured recovery interval before the zero-rate measurement.
fa_test_that_discriminates: Repeat stationary measurements at fixed delays after a controlled impulse.

symptom_in_logs: Optional camera-pack corner sharpness differs left to right.
hidden_cause: The unseeded accessory lens seat is laterally displaced.
red_herring: Exposure varies with the camera-test fixture.
cheat_fix: Crop away the soft corners.
real_fix: Reseat the lens and restore the mechanical locating surface.
fa_test_that_discriminates: Measure chart sharpness while rotating only the lens assembly.

symptom_in_logs: Optional camera-pack best-focus position differs across the field.
hidden_cause: The unseeded accessory imager plane is tilted relative to the lens.
red_herring: Lens supplier lots correlate with the affected boards.
cheat_fix: Use a center-only focus score.
real_fix: Correct the imager seating and verify field-wide focus.
fa_test_that_discriminates: Sweep focus on a flat chart and compare the peak position at each corner.

symptom_in_logs: T-OPT-01 uniformity fails on one nest while reference parts remain stable elsewhere.
hidden_cause: The optical fixture reference correction is stale.
red_herring: One incoming dome lot mostly used that nest.
cheat_fix: Broaden uniformity tolerance for that nest.
real_fix: Recalibrate the optical fixture using traceable reference units.
fa_test_that_discriminates: Run the same retained units on a reference nest and the suspect nest.

symptom_in_logs: Touch readings jump with nest motion even after settling.
hidden_cause: An intermittent ground strap changes the fixture reference potential.
red_herring: Failures appeared after a calibration-code release.
cheat_fix: Average away intermittent touch spikes.
real_fix: Replace the strap and verify continuity during nest motion.
fa_test_that_discriminates: Monitor ground impedance while articulating the nest with an unchanged unit.

symptom_in_logs: T-OPT-01 uniformity fails despite cal_applied equal to 1.
hidden_cause: The diffuser is tilted on its locating shoulder.
red_herring: A second-source light component is present.
cheat_fix: Apply an excessive optical compensation table.
real_fix: Reseat the diffuser and correct the locating operation.
fa_test_that_discriminates: Measure diffuser position before and after a controlled reseat.

symptom_in_logs: T-AUD-01 snr_db stays low after a temperature return to nominal.
hidden_cause: Adhesive squeeze-out narrows the microphone acoustic path.
red_herring: Warm units fail more frequently.
cheat_fix: Raise the speaker drive to mask the noise.
real_fix: Control adhesive volume and restore the acoustic path.
fa_test_that_discriminates: Inspect the path and compare acoustic transfer before and after adhesive removal.

symptom_in_logs: Touch and optical retests stabilize only after additional dwell.
hidden_cause: The operator skips the released pre-calibration conditioning step.
red_herring: One material lot was staged during the skipped dwell.
cheat_fix: Record a nominal dwell without performing it.
real_fix: Restore the conditioning step and record its completion.
fa_test_that_discriminates: Observe the actual dwell with an independent timer and repeat the same units.

symptom_in_logs: Several tests fail only when one manually selected fixture profile is active.
hidden_cause: The wrong approved profile is selected for the current build variant.
red_herring: A software deployment occurred during the same shift.
cheat_fix: Manually override each failing result.
real_fix: Select the matching profile and verify variant-to-profile selection.
fa_test_that_discriminates: Rerun a reference unit with the correct and incorrect profiles.

symptom_in_logs: Cold second-source units show cal_applied=0 and uniformity=0.18; warm units show uniformity=0.02.
hidden_cause: Cold second-source LED driver_ready_ms is 180; buggy firmware writes at t=50 ms without ready-wait or readback, so the calibration write is dropped. Warm driver_ready_ms is 20.
red_herring: The cold units cluster on a second-source component lot and fixture.
cheat_fix: Widen the optical uniformity limit to pass the dim dome.
real_fix: Wait until ready, write calibration, read back, and retry once.
fa_test_that_discriminates: Compare driver-ready timing and calibration readback on cold and warm units; a physical dome defect stays at uniformity=0.22 regardless of calibration.

symptom_in_logs: Slow-nest units show baseline_drift=85; normal units show baseline_drift=8.
hidden_cause: Buggy firmware captures the touch baseline at t=40 ms, before the slow grounded nest settles at nest_settle_ms=120.
red_herring: The affected units cluster on the grounded test nest.
cheat_fix: Raise the allowed baseline drift above 85 counts.
real_fix: Capture the baseline after nest settling and verify its stability.
fa_test_that_discriminates: Capture the same unit at t=40 ms and after nest_settle_ms=120; compare baseline drift with the nest state held constant.

symptom_in_logs: T-OPT-01 uniformity remains 0.22 even with calibration applied.
hidden_cause: A physical dome defect scatters light unevenly and cannot be corrected by firmware.
red_herring: The same units also use a slower-starting component lot.
cheat_fix: Widen the optical limit to hide the physical defect.
real_fix: Replace the defective dome and contain the affected material lot.
fa_test_that_discriminates: Swap only the dome on the same calibrated unit and compare uniformity.

symptom_in_logs: T-AUD-01 snr_db falls after the gasket is compressed to its normal seat.
hidden_cause: Gasket stiffness exceeds the intended range and distorts the acoustic seal.
red_herring: The assembly fixture recently changed.
cheat_fix: Apply an arbitrary gain increase.
real_fix: Replace the gasket lot and verify the material stiffness range.
fa_test_that_discriminates: Measure gasket force-displacement and swap only the gasket on a retained unit.

symptom_in_logs: T-PWR-01 records an implausible rail_mv scale despite nominal probe voltage.
hidden_cause: The station parser converts the instrument scale twice.
red_herring: An incoming battery lot changed at the same time.
cheat_fix: Divide displayed values without correcting stored records.
real_fix: Correct the parser conversion and reprocess traceable raw readings.
fa_test_that_discriminates: Compare the raw instrument packet, an independent meter, and the parsed value.

symptom_in_logs: Programmed variant differs from the recipe requested in the run log.
hidden_cause: A station cache returns the previous variant configuration.
red_herring: Operators alternate variants during one shift.
cheat_fix: Relabel the unit to match the cached recipe.
real_fix: Invalidate the cache on variant changes and verify the applied recipe identity.
fa_test_that_discriminates: Alternate two fixture-only variant requests and read back the applied identity.

symptom_in_logs: Warm units at unit_temp_c=52 show snr_db=11; cool units show snr_db=24.
hidden_cause: The microphone temperature table is valid only through 45 C and is exhausted for queued units arriving at 52 C.
red_herring: The microphone material lot follows the warm queue.
cheat_fix: Lower the SNR limit below 11 dB.
real_fix: Correct temperature-table handling and verify compensation over the operating range.
fa_test_that_discriminates: Run the same microphone at a cool temperature and 52 C while inspecting temperature-table selection.

symptom_in_logs: Calibration readback changes after a cold boot despite an unchanged applied recipe.
hidden_cause: Firmware truncates the final sample before committing the calibration accumulator.
red_herring: The board lot changes near the first failing build.
cheat_fix: Copy the previous unit calibration into the current unit.
real_fix: Commit only after the final calibration sample is accumulated and checked.
fa_test_that_discriminates: Replay a fixed sample sequence and compare the accumulator before and after boot.

symptom_in_logs: T-IMU-01 bias_dps is wrong only after restoration of saved offsets.
hidden_cause: Firmware applies the saved axes in an inconsistent order.
red_herring: Sensor markings vary between lots.
cheat_fix: Suppress offset restoration on every unit.
real_fix: Restore offsets by stable axis identity and verify each readback.
fa_test_that_discriminates: Inject distinct fixture-only offsets per axis and inspect the restored mapping.

symptom_in_logs: The report shows one test passing when its raw measured value fails the released rule.
hidden_cause: The report mapper reads a neighboring test result field.
red_herring: The two tests usually fail together on one shift.
cheat_fix: Hide the raw measured value from the report.
real_fix: Map each result using its exact test identifier and retain the raw measurement.
fa_test_that_discriminates: Feed deliberately different results for adjacent test IDs and inspect the exported rows.
